name: docflare-ai
description: Open-source, zero-cost AI site search & chatbot widget running 100% on Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, Vectorize and D1.

VECTOR_INDEX.description: Vectorize index for `@cf/baai/bge-m3` embeddings: set **Dimensions = 1024** and **Metric = cosine**. Any other shape breaks indexing.

DB.description: D1 database for sites, pages and chat history. Apply the schema once after the first deploy with `bun run db:migrate` (see README).

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the `/api/sites/*` management routes and the `/admin` page. Replace the example value with a random one of at least 16 characters, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`; the example value is refused outside localhost.

scripts.deploy: bun run build:widget && bun scripts/wrangler.ts deploy
scripts.db:migrate: bun scripts/wrangler.ts d1 migrations apply DB --remote
